content_of_post_to_answer: How much of your reality is controlled by your mindset?
answer: Mindset does not create reality in the sense that it can erase external limits, but it strongly shapes the reality we experience by influencing what we notice, attempt, tolerate, and interpret. Two people can face the same event and live in very different worlds because their assumptions filter the meaning they assign to it. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone curious. The mind does not control everything that happens; it controls much of what becomes possible afterward.
